title: Alpha Feran
summary: Alpha Feran calls other ferans into the fight.
overview: Alpha Feran calls other ferans into the fight.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Expect the first call ten seconds after engagement and further calls every fifteen seconds.
Control nearby ferans before committing to the boss.
Have a tank collect any ferans brought into combat by the howl.
